YOUR 3 BEST ROUTES

Ranked by how many fresher jobs actually exist this year, then how well each fits you.

1. IT services (TCS, Infosys, Wipro)
Jobs: fewer each year

Why this suits you: the largest number of fresher seats and the shortest time to a first salary; and this is the path where a tier-3 college matters least: open tests like TCS NQT and Infosys off-campus do not look at your college.

Careful: Fewer jobs each year, but still the biggest and most realistic first job from most colleges. Treat it as a two-year start, not the destination.

Get my 90-day plan
See how we ranked this
2. Infrastructure and energy
Jobs: steady

Why this suits you: site is where the first years happen; liking site visits and machines is the best predictor of staying; and mechanical enters through NTPC, plant erection and O&M, and wind projects.

Careful: Possible at a state discom, PWD or metro, but EPC and PSU postings cross states.

Get my 90-day plan
See how we ranked this
3. Startups and non-engineering roles
Jobs: growing

Why this suits you: bank PO programmes, BPO walk-ins, fintech ops and sales roles hire in weeks, not exam cycles; the pay is modest but immediate; and this path has the fastest time to first salary of all nine; walk-ins and PO programmes start within a month or two.

Careful: Yes, and this is the widest route for tier-3 graduates right now: bank PO programmes, BPO and ITES associate walk-ins, insurance and fintech operations, hospitality trainee programmes.

path:
Infrastructure and energy
Jobs: steady

Steady, large route, but most new jobs are technician-level; graduate seats sit at EPCs and PSUs

IS IT REALISTIC FROM YOUR COLLEGE?

Colleges companies rarely visit: Yes, more than most paths. Site engineering is short of people who will actually go to site, and the GATE route to PSUs is open to everyone. What substitutes for the brand is a site internship or a Power Grid or NTPC graduate apprenticeship under NATS, a STAAD or ETAP or PVsyst portfolio, and a GATE score. The trap is stopping at diploma-level site supervisor work at a subcontractor; aim for the EPC or PSU payroll.

FRESHER PAY
₹3 to 8 lakh/yr

Private EPC GETs earn 3 to 6; PSU executive trainees (NTPC, Power Grid, NHAI) earn 5 to 8 with allowances on top; site roles add hardship and site allowances that are not in the CTC figure.

JOBS A YEAR
—

No stat counts graduate engineer hires per year. CEEW projects 44 lakh clean-energy jobs by 2030, but about 43% are rooftop solar and mostly technician-level; PSU engineer intake via GATE is in the hundreds per company (NTPC about 500, NPCIL 330); EPC GET intake is unpublished. Non-IT sectors are driving fresher hiring growth in 2026.

Skills employers ask for
AutoCAD · must
STAAD.Pro · must
ETAP / power systems analysis · must
Primavera P6 / MS Project · must
Site engineering and safety · must
Quantity surveying and estimation · must
PVsyst solar PV design
Revit / BIM
GATE (Civil)
GATE (Electrical)
Geotechnical and surveying basics
Renewable energy fundamentals
Power grid and transmission basics
Excel and business analysis

What employers check right now:

B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or (for solar and grid) EEE or Electronics; PSU notices ask for 60 to 65% aggregate and an age limit around 28 to 30
A valid GATE score for NTPC, Power Grid, NHAI and other PSU trainee posts; EPC campus drives use their own online tests
Tool skill that recruiters name in postings: AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, Revit or BIM for civil; ETAP for electrical; Primavera P6 or MS Project for planning; PVsyst for solar design
Site exposure: an internship or NATS apprenticeship where you handled a bar-bending schedule, a pour, a cable pull or a substation test
Basic quantity estimation and billing (BOQ, measurement book) because most fresher EPC roles are site or planning engineer
Willingness to live at remote project sites for the first years and to move between projects

2026 में आपके लिए कौन सी इंजीनियरिंग नौकरियाँ सच में हैं, और इस हफ्ते क्या करें?

10 सवाल, 2 मिनट। आपको मिलेंगे आपके 3 सबसे अच्छे रास्ते, अगले 90 दिनों का प्लान, और वे कंपनियाँ जो अभी आप जैसे फ्रेशर्स को ले रही हैं।

शुरू करें (2 मिनट)
मेरा प्लान खोलें

105 फ्रेशर विज्ञापन जाँचे गए · 2026-09-21 · 83 स्किल, सब मुफ्त सीखने के लिंक के साथ

यह कैसे काम करता है
1
10 छोटे सवालों के जवाब दें। टाइप नहीं करना।
2
देखें 3 रास्ते जो आपके कॉलेज से सच में संभव हैं, और क्यों।
3
90 दिन का प्लान पाएँ, मुफ्त सीखने के लिंक और हर महीने एक छोटा सबूत।
4
सबूत के लिंक जोड़ें। असली नौकरी विज्ञापनों से अपना मेल बढ़ते देखें।
